gameDescriptionHtml:
Save Monster High and join the Boo Crew by creating your authentic monster self in this spooktacular mystery adventure!

Discover the secrets of the Hidden Rooms, and what is happening at Monster High. It’s your first day at Monster High, where all monsters are welcome… but some strange events are happening.

Can you uncover the mystery of the doors and ancient keys and bring the school back to its authentic, spooky self? Play and discover its skulltimate secrets.

Game Features

  • SOLVE THE SKULLTIMATE SECRETS – Discover the secrets of the Hidden Rooms, and what is happening at Monster High™.
  • CREATE YOUR CHARACTER – Be yourself. Be unique. Be a Monster. Create your unique monster character with a vault full of different monster kinds, skills, and scary-chic looks to choose from.
  • MEET YOUR BOO CREW – Clawdeen, Draculaura, and Frankie are your new beasties! As the newest member of the Boo Crew, you’re in for one hex-citing adventure!
  • DISCOVER THE WORLD OF Monster High – Explore the school with your beasties Clawdeen Wolf, Draculaura, and Frankie Stein, and find creeperific clues and powerful new skills.
  • UNLOCK NEW SKILLS – Unlock incredible skills such as the Vampire Jump or the Gorgon Dash.
  • GLOW UP YOUR STYLE – Swap Monster Points for new fierce lurks and fashions!
